prompt: A DML trigger inserts into an audit table but only records one row even when 10 rows are updated. What is the likely cause?
explanation: Triggers fire once per statement; you must process all rows via the inserted/deleted pseudo-tables set-based, not assume a single row.

options.text: The trigger uses row-by-row logic instead of the inserted/deleted tables
Triggers can only see one row ever
The audit table lacks an index
AFTER triggers don't fire on UPDATE
